_comment: Release Impact: shared classes to IGNORE in code-change detection (a common logger/audit/utility used by many routes would otherwise mark every API as impacted). To ship team defaults add a "patterns" array of case-insensitive globs matched against the bean name, the class name or the repo path, e.g. {"patterns": ["commonAuditProcessor", "*Logger*", "**/common/*.java"]}. This comment-only placeholder seeds nothing; users edit the list in the app under Config > Ignored classes.
